source_text.body:
Manage family email, calendar and school chats
An agent named Anna, reached by text or WhatsApp, manages family email, calendar and school WhatsApp groups and automates forms and schedules.
·
Jul 7, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Anna is reached by text or WhatsApp and works autonomously 24/7 across family email, calendar, and school WhatsApp groups to handle admin. The agent automates the tasks both parents forgot. No details on access setup or human intervention points are given.
How it went
Trusted by thousands of parents.
Worth knowing
Start for free.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Act as my family assistant that I can message by [text or WhatsApp]. Each morning, read my email and the school group chats I connect, then give me a short list of new events, forms to fill out, and deadlines for [kids' names]. Propose calendar entries for anything that needs one, but pause and show me each entry or reply before you add it or send anything.
Original source: https://x.com/DilaniKahawala/status/2074378439692636519
